title: Frontend Developer - rozwijaj z nami produkt, który chroni dane na całym świecie!
description:

Cześć! 👋

Jeśli lubisz techniczne wyzwania, cenisz współpracę i chcesz rozwijać się razem z produktem o globalnym zasięgu – poznajmy się!

Rozwijać i utrzymywać interfejs użytkownika naszej flagowej aplikacji.

Projektować i wdrażać nowoczesne, intuicyjne oraz wydajne rozwiązania frontendowe.

Współpracować z zespołami backendu i UX/UI, aby przekładać potrzeby użytkowników na świetne doświadczenia.

Dbać o jakość kodu, testowanie i stabilność aplikacji.

Mieć realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju interfejsu i wykorzystywane technologie.

🧠 Czego szukamy?
Nie oczekujemy, że będziesz wiedzieć wszystko. Zależy nam jednak na solidnych podstawach i praktycznym doświadczeniu.
Must-have:
Minimum 2 lata komercyjnego doświadczenia w developmentcie frontendowym.

Bardzo dobra znajomość Angulara – preferowane wersje 21/22.

Doświadczenie z bibliotekami UI, takimi jak Angular Material i Bootstrap.

Umiejętność pisania testów jednostkowych z wykorzystaniem Vitest.

Dobra znajomość RxJS i programowania reaktywnego.

Praktyczna znajomość NgRx i zarządzania stanem aplikacji.

Angielski na poziomie minimum B2.

Samodzielność, proaktywność i umiejętność szukania rozwiązań.

Dodatkowe plusy ⭐
Znajomość Storybooka i tworzenia komponentów UI w izolacji.

Doświadczenie w testach end-to-end, np. z wykorzystaniem Cypress.

Praca w metodyce Agile/Scrum.

📍 Gdzie i za ile?
Lokalizacja: Warszawa, Bielsko-Biała lub praca w pełni zdalna – wybór należy do Ciebie.

Wynagrodzenie: 10 000–16 000 PLN netto + VAT na umowie B2B.

🔥 Co zyskasz, dołączając do Storware?
🌍 Globalny produkt, realne wyzwania
Będziesz rozwijać rozwiązanie wykorzystywane na międzynarodowym rynku. Twoja praca będzie miała znaczenie – nie tylko w kodzie, ale przede wszystkim dla użytkowników.
🛠️ Wpływ, a nie tylko realizacja zadań
Cenimy inicjatywę, wiedzę i dobre pomysły. Możesz współdecydować o rozwoju produktu oraz technologiach, z których korzystamy.
🏡 Elastyczność na Twoich zasadach
Wolisz biuro czy własny domowy kąt? Wspieramy pracę zdalną i pomagamy zadbać o wygodne stanowisko pracy.
📚 Rozwój, który ma sens
Udostępniamy szkolenia techniczne naszych partnerów, organizujemy szkolenia wewnętrzne i zapewniamy dostęp do wartościowych materiałów, dzięki którym możesz rozwijać swoje kompetencje.
🤝 Zespół, na który możesz liczyć
Współpraca to jedna z naszych kluczowych wartości. Dzielimy się wiedzą, wspieramy się i pomagamy sobie nawzajem – również wtedy, gdy pojawiają się trudniejsze wyzwania.
🎁 Onboarding bez stresu
Zależy nam, żebyś od początku czuł/a się częścią zespołu. Dlatego przygotowaliśmy sprawdzony proces wdrożenia, który pozwoli Ci spokojnie poznać produkt, ludzi i sposób naszej pracy.
🦾 Brzmi jak coś dla Ciebie?
Jeśli Angular to Twoje środowisko, a tworzenie dobrego produktu daje Ci satysfakcję, dołącz do Storware i rozwijaj z nami technologie, które chronią dane na całym świecie!
👉 Wyślij nam swoje CV przez formularz i porozmawiajmy. Kto wie – może to właśnie początek naszej wspólnej historii?

Sterke kennis van Typescript en Angular of een vergelijkbaar framework;

Goede communicatieve vaardigheden zowel in het Nederlands als Engels.

Kennis en/of ervaring met Python en Docker.

Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten. Naarmate machines complexer worden en de verwachtingen van klanten stijgen, moeten machinebouwers hun services continu professionaliseren om de concurrentie voor te blijven. En dat is precies waar wij in beeld komen.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Deepdesk
description:
About Deepdesk

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.

What You’ll Be Doing
• Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.
• Keep our databases fast and reliable.
• Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.
• Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.
• Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required.
• Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics.
• Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code.
• Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering.
• Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed.

Our Stack
• Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go.
• Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API.
• Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.
• Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.
• Front end: TypeScript and React.
• Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For
• Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.
• Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.
• Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.
• Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength.
• A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.
• Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.
• Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.
• A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

Why Join Us?
• Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details]
• A small team working with major enterprise clients.
• Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale.
• Full autonomy and full ownership of your work.
• High standards, trust and plenty of humour.
• The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres.
• Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract.

Information Security Responsibilities
All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:
• Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.
• Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.
• Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.
• Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.
• Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.
• Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.
Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
We’re looking for a pragmatic, security-minded Full-Stack Developer to help build and scale Fluence’s B2B products used by clinicians, researchers, and organizations in psychedelic-assisted therapy and mental health. You’ll work closely with and report to our Senior AI & Design Lead to turn product requirements into robust, secure, and well-documented applications, as well as maintain existing ones.

What you’ll do

Build and maintain full-stack web applications using React and Next.js .

Architect reliable, performant backends and APIs; familiarity with AWS (Lambda, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, RDS/DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, Cognito, etc.) is important. AWS Bedrock and AWS CloudTrail experience is a plus.

Implement secure authentication, authorization, and role-based access for clinician, admin, and other user workflows.

Design data models and flows with privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations in mind.

Integrate with internal and external APIs and third-party services used in our B2B stack.

Experience with LLM/AI features in production (guardrails, logging, security considerations).

Implement logging, monitor performance, and ship production-quality code. Datadog and Sentry experience is a plus.

Collaborate directly with the Senior AI & Design Lead for clear ownership, feedback, and iteration.

description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.

About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.
Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.
We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.
Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists
As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

What You'll Do

Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)
